_comment: Single source of truth for the managed<->native boundary (ADR-002,
Hand-edits to those files are forbidden; implementations of the
Handles are {index+1, generation} packed in an i32; 0 is never valid.
Setters take scalar floats (no struct-by-value ABI questions); getters

functions.name: ps2ur_debug_log
functions.doc: UTF-8 message to the EE console at Info level. Diagnostic path; the per-call string copy is accepted (ADR-002 cstr rules).

functions.name: ps2ur_entity_create
functions.doc: Creates a root entity (parentHandle 0) or a child. Returns the new handle, or 0 if the entity table is full.

functions.name: ps2ur_entity_destroy
functions.doc: Destroys the entity and its children. The handle's generation is retired: stale handles fail alive() forever after.

functions.name: ps2ur_entity_alive
functions.doc: 1 if the handle refers to a live entity, else 0. This is the native truth behind Unity's destroyed-compares-null semantics.

functions.name: ps2ur_entity_set_active
functions.doc: GameObject.SetActive: the renderer skips inactive subtrees.

functions.name: ps2ur_entity_get_active
functions.doc: activeSelf (not the inherited activeInHierarchy).

functions.name: ps2ur_tf_get_parent
functions.doc: Parent handle, or 0 for a root entity.

functions.name: ps2ur_tf_set_parent
functions.doc: Reparents (parentHandle 0 = make root). Local TRS is NOT adjusted here; Transform.SetParent(worldPositionStays) does that math on the managed side where Unity's semantics live.

functions.name: ps2ur_tf_get_child
functions.doc: Child handle by index, or 0 if out of range.

functions.name: ps2ur_anim_update
functions.doc: Advances every animator by dt and writes their root motion back to entity transforms. The managed dispatcher calls this AFTER Update and coroutines and BEFORE LateUpdate, which is the ordering Unity users rely on (M9 task 4).

functions.name: ps2ur_animator_play
functions.doc: Jumps the entity's animator to the named baked state with no blend. Returns 1 when the state exists, 0 otherwise. Names are FNV-1a-64 hashes truncated to 32 bits, matching the exporter.

functions.name: ps2ur_animator_crossfade
functions.doc: Starts a crossfade to the named state over a duration in SECONDS. Returns 1 when the state exists.

functions.name: ps2ur_animator_is_blending
functions.doc: 1 while a crossfade is running on the entity's animator.

functions.name: ps2ur_input_update
functions.doc: Polls every pad. The managed dispatcher calls this once at the top of the frame, before any script runs.

functions.name: ps2ur_input_button
functions.doc: 1 while the button is held. 'button' is the ps2ur::input::Button ordinal.

functions.name: ps2ur_input_axis
functions.doc: Stick axis in -1..1 with the deadzone applied; Y is positive up.

functions.name: ps2ur_input_pressure
functions.doc: Analog button pressure, 0..255, or 0 when the pad does not report it.

functions.name: ps2ur_input_set_rumble
functions.doc: Small motor is on/off; large motor takes 0..255.

functions.name: ps2ur_scene_load_begin
functions.doc: Starts an async scene load into the host-provided scene buffer (bridge::bind_scene_buffer). additive != 0 appends to the running world instead of replacing it. Returns 1 when the load started. Only one load is in flight at a time; starting a second while one runs is refused.

functions.name: ps2ur_scene_load_update
functions.doc: Advances the load by at most byteBudget bytes and returns the LoadState ordinal (0 Idle, 1 Reading, 2 Parsing, 3 Ready, 4 Failed). A budget of 0 means one chunk.

functions.name: ps2ur_scene_load_progress
functions.doc: 0..1 across read and parse together -- what AsyncOperation.progress returns.

functions.name: ps2ur_scene_load_state
functions.doc: The LoadState ordinal without advancing the load.

functions.name: ps2ur_scene_load_set_allow_activation
functions.doc: AsyncOperation.allowSceneActivation. 0 parks a completed read at progress 0.9 without swapping the world; setting it back to 1 lets the next update finish. Defaults to 1 on every begin.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_step
functions.doc: Advances the physics world by one fixed step against the scene's own transforms. The managed dispatcher calls this from its FixedUpdate loop, before FixedUpdate scripts run.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_set_gravity
functions.doc: Physics.gravity.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_fixed_timestep
functions.doc: Time.fixedDeltaTime as the solver sees it.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_set_layers_collide
functions.doc: One cell of Unity's layer collision matrix. Symmetric: setting (a,b) also sets (b,a).

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_raycast
functions.doc: Physics.Raycast. Returns 1 on a hit and fills the caller-owned P2RaycastHit; 0 leaves it untouched.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_spherecast
functions.doc: Physics.SphereCast, same contract as the raycast above.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_overlap_sphere
functions.doc: Physics.OverlapSphere. Runs the query, keeps the result in a native scratch list and returns how many were FOUND -- which may exceed what the list can hold, so a caller can tell it was truncated. Read the entries with ps2ur_phys_overlap_result.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_overlap_result
functions.doc: Collider index from the last overlap query, or -1 when the index is past what the scratch list actually holds.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_contact_count
functions.doc: Contacts produced by the last step. The managed dispatcher reads the whole list in ONE interop call per frame (M11 task 3) rather than one call per event.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_get_contact
functions.doc: Fills a caller-owned P2Contact from the last step's list. Returns 0 if the index is out of range.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_contacts_dropped
functions.doc: Contacts that did not fit this frame. Non-zero means the game is silently missing events, and the runtime says so rather than hiding it.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_add_body
functions.doc: Creates a Rigidbody driving the given collider. Returns the body index, or -1 when the table is full.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_body_add_force
functions.doc: Rigidbody.AddForce in Force mode; the accumulator is cleared each step.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_body_set_damping
functions.doc: Rigidbody.linearDamping / angularDamping. Separate from add_body because they are settable at any time; a body created without them would silently ignore what the scene exported.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_body_set_flags
functions.doc: Rigidbody.useGravity / isKinematic / freezeRotation. add_body takes the first two as well, but only as initial values; without this setter changing either after binding would be a property that reads back what you set and changes nothing.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_collider_count
functions.doc: Colliders in the table, including the ones the PHYS section baked. Walked once at boot to map collider indices to GameObjects for the contact callbacks.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_collider_entity
functions.doc: The entity HANDLE a collider rides on, or 0 for baked static geometry that belongs to no entity.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_collider_for_entity
functions.doc: The collider index riding on an entity, or -1. Baked colliders arrive from the PHYS section already bound to their entity.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_add_character
functions.doc: Creates a CharacterController on an entity. Returns its index, or -1.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_move_character
functions.doc: CharacterController.Move. Writes the position reached back to the entity transform and returns Unity's CollisionFlags bits.

functions.name: ps2ur_phys_character_grounded
functions.doc: CharacterController.isGrounded.

functions.name: ps2ur_audio_play
functions.doc: Starts a clip on the mixer and returns its voice handle, or 0 when every voice is busy with something more important -- a dropped sound is normal, never an error. Looping is baked into the clip at encode. When 'spatial' is nonzero the voice registers for per-frame pan/attenuation against the entity named by 'entity_handle' (M12.5 task 2).

functions.name: ps2ur_audio_stop
functions.doc: Stops a voice. 0 and stale handles are no-ops.

functions.name: ps2ur_audio_is_playing
functions.doc: 1 while the voice is sounding. AudioSource.isPlaying reads this.

functions.name: ps2ur_audio_set_volume
functions.doc: Live volume change on a sounding voice. A spatial voice keeps its per-frame pan; a 2D voice sits centred.

functions.name: ps2ur_audio_clip_count
functions.doc: Clips loaded from the SND section.

functions.name: ps2ur_audio_clip_seconds
functions.doc: A clip's duration in seconds, from its sample count and pitch. AudioClip.length reads this.

functions.name: ps2ur_prefs_set_int
functions.doc: PlayerPrefs.SetInt into the M10 memcard store (in memory until ps2ur_prefs_save). Keys cap at 24 bytes, the store at 64 entries (deviation 28). cstr use is deliberate: cold path, tiny strings, and hashed keys would make GetString impossible.

functions.name: ps2ur_prefs_set_float
functions.doc: PlayerPrefs.SetFloat.

functions.name: ps2ur_prefs_set_string
functions.doc: PlayerPrefs.SetString. Values cap at 48 bytes (deviation 28).

functions.name: ps2ur_prefs_get_int
functions.doc: PlayerPrefs.GetInt with its fallback.

functions.name: ps2ur_prefs_get_float
functions.doc: PlayerPrefs.GetFloat with its fallback.

functions.name: ps2ur_prefs_has_key
functions.doc: PlayerPrefs.HasKey.

functions.name: ps2ur_prefs_delete_key
functions.doc: PlayerPrefs.DeleteKey.

functions.name: ps2ur_prefs_delete_all
functions.doc: PlayerPrefs.DeleteAll.

functions.name: ps2ur_prefs_string_length
functions.doc: Byte length of a string value, or -1 when the key is absent or not a string. A returned pointer would need an owner the boundary refuses to have, so GetString reads length + bytes and caches managed-side.

functions.name: ps2ur_prefs_string_byte
functions.doc: Byte at index of a string value, or -1 past the end. Cold path by design: a 48-byte value read once and cached.

functions.name: ps2ur_prefs_save
functions.doc: Writes the store to memory card port 0 under the identity the host set at boot. Returns memcard::Status: 0 Ok, then NoCard, NotFormatted, Full, WriteProtected, NotFound, Error. Unity's Save cannot fail; this one reports through PS2Memory.LastSaveError (deviation 29).

functions.name: ps2ur_particles_play
functions.doc: PS2ParticleSystem.Play (ADR-011): starts emission and fires the authored burst. Addressed by the owning entity's handle.

functions.name: ps2ur_particles_stop
functions.doc: PS2ParticleSystem.Stop: emission ceases, live particles play out -- Unity's Stop semantics.

functions.name: ps2ur_particles_emit
functions.doc: PS2ParticleSystem.Emit(count). Spawns up to the pool's remaining capacity; the budget is the contract.

functions.name: ps2ur_particles_is_playing
functions.doc: 1 while the system is emitting.

functions.name: ps2ur_particles_count
functions.doc: Live particles right now; PS2ParticleSystem.particleCount.

functions.name: ps2ur_ui_element_for_entity
functions.doc: The uGUI draw-table index for an entity, or -1. Elements are flat-table indexed like colliders; managed UI components hold this for their setters.

functions.name: ps2ur_ui_set_rect
functions.doc: Moves/resizes an element in screen pixels, top-left origin. Layout was baked at export; this is how scripts (and the Slider fill) animate it.

functions.name: ps2ur_ui_get_colour
functions.doc: The element's CURRENT tint, RGBA8 with alpha in the PS2 0..0x80 range. CreateUIGraphic seeds the managed Graphic from this so the focus highlight can restore the AUTHORED colour, not an assumed white. Out-of-range elements return opaque white.

functions.name: ps2ur_ui_set_colour
functions.doc: Tint, RGBA8 with alpha already in the PS2 0..0x80 range. Graphic.color and the navigation focus highlight write through this.

functions.name: ps2ur_ui_set_text
functions.doc: Replaces a text element's string (48-byte cap, baked 8x8 font). cstr on a set-on-change path, not per frame.

functions.name: ps2ur_ui_set_visible
functions.doc: Shows/hides an element; Behaviour.enabled on the managed graphics.
